name: Pieve a Nievole (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pieve a Nievole (a yellow griffin on blue) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI PIEVE A NIEVOLE in black arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Pieve a Nievole, a comune in Tuscany; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Pieve a Nievole arms — yellow griffin on blue, crowned, within branches
inscription COMUNE DI PIEVE A NIEVOLE arched above the arms
